corrections: Sea biography confirms engineering bachelor’s from Shanghai Jiao Tong University and MBA from Stanford Graduate School of Business. Do not use the Wikipedia infobox BA label, infer PhD or invent graduation dates.

Sea chairman and CEO tenure begins May 2009. SEC 2017 annual report says Garena Interactive Holding Limited incorporated May 8, 2009 and renamed Sea Limited April 8, 2017. The 2009 timeline uses month precision and predecessor wording; it is not a claim that the Sea brand or Shopee launched in 2009.

AirPay launched in Vietnam April 2014 and Thailand June 2014. Shopee app rolled out across seven regional markets over several weeks from June through early July 2015; websites followed in 2016. No claim that all launches occurred on one exact day or that the founder personally built every platform.

SEC 2017 annual report distinguishes NYSE listing/trading October 20, 2017 from offering close October 24. Symbol SE, not PDD or Nasdaq. No share-price, fundraising or current valuation claims included.

Club announcement February 14, 2020 identifies Sea assuming 100% ownership of Home United, renamed Lion City Sailors, and appointing Li chairman. Corporate acquisition is not described as a personal cash purchase; Li is not a player or head coach. Current CNA reporting corroborates continuing chairmanship.

CNA election report dates FAS election April 28, 2025. AFF summary published May 1 corroborates 2025–2029 term but its publication date is not election day. Unopposed slate followed rival slate disqualification according to CNA; no assertion of a contested victory or unanimous individual vote.

May 8, 2025 announcement is SeaMoney-to-Monee rebrand and new Singapore digital-finance headquarters opening, not the first launch of digital finance. Current names are Garena, Shopee and Monee; not all are banks and no unsupported group-wide banking license claim.

November 10, 2026 announcement reports results for quarter ended September 30. Timeline dates publication and attributed CEO comments, not fiscal quarter end. No full independent audit of financial statements claimed.

CNA November 13 report updated November 16 assesses football investment, youth pathways and league competitiveness. Text attributes the discussion and does not credit all team achievements to Li, assert wrongdoing, or treat analyst concerns as adjudicated misconduct.
Birth year remains unresolved; contemporary age ranges do not establish a unique year. Country is Singapore by citizenship, not China by birthplace. Net worth and personal family details omitted.
